cnq.review: Mat125 and Eco135 contain almost similar mathematical contents. The only difference is Eco135 emphasizes on economic applications and a solid base is required in maths. Eco172 is stats. If you're good in maths you can take these 3 together. Otherwise don't. And if you still wanna take these 3 together, do eco135 under Cnq and eco172 under Mzq. It will become easier for you to have a grip on these courses.
